title: Replace RankedList inside the score and library views with data/sections.ts
description: Since the sidebars went (apricitus-f22d407a), ScoreView and Library still build a RankedList (search box, window seg, Mine, New button, rows) that is never mounted; they use it only to load items and pick the top one. Load through data/sections.ts instead, drop the dead DOM and ui/ranked-list.ts if nothing else uses it, and stop the score view auto-opening its top score while it's hidden.
